comment: Config for tools/m68k2c.py for the native build (native/): everything from the reset vector ($200) and the VBlank interrupt ($4B5C), with the harness roots. restart: $4BF8 (reset the stack, re-enter the frame loop) and $4A06 (restart): the host calls them fresh. poll: $3DC (the frame wait in $3B8) and $C262 (the 300-frame wait after an inn): the host runs a frame and the interrupt there. exits: $4CB4 (hang: no free task slot), reported by the host. Addresses only.
